# MeritMoon: Full Platform Specification & Knowledge Graph

> **Platform:** MeritMoon  
> **Tagline:** A Kinder Mind Changes Everything  
> **Mission:** The discipline-first meditation platform rooted in ancient wisdom.  
> **Official Hub:** https://meritmoon.com  
> **Canonical API & Web Host:** https://meritmoon.com  
> **License:** Proprietary Platform / Open Community  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

MeritMoon is an ancient-wisdom meditation platform designed for serious practitioners seeking real inner transformation rather than superficial wellness gamification. It combines rigorous mindfulness methods (Ānāpāna, Jhāna, Vipassanā, Mettā) with modern cross-platform software engineering (Rails 8, React 19, Flutter 3).

### The Four Foundational Curricula:
- **Breath (Ānāpāna):** Direct observation of breath sensation at the nostril aperture.
- **Absorption (Jhāna):** Cultivation of deep meditative joy (*Pīti*), stillness (*Sukha*), and unified awareness (*Ekaggatā*).
- **Insight (Vipassanā):** Direct perception of impermanence (*Anicca*), non-self (*Anattā*), and reality as it is.
- **Loving-Kindness (Mettā):** Systematic radiance of unconditional benevolence toward all beings.

---

## 2. Economics & The Merit System

MeritMoon is built on the ancient tradition of **Dāna** (generosity):
- **100% Free Core Practice:** No feature paywalls, subscriptions, or advertisements lock away foundational practice.
- **Pay with Discipline:** Maintaining consistent daily meditation unlocks continuous progress.
- **Pay with Devotion:** Practitioners can voluntarily sponsor monk teachers, retreats, and monastery upkeep directly.

---

## 3. Brand Identity & Visual Language

- **Visual Theme:** Forest Moonlit Night (Deep forest canopy, silver-mint moonlight, emerald foliage, ruby dusk highlights, and golden starbeams).
- **Typography:**
  - Display / Eyebrows: `Moonjelly` (custom display serif)
  - Headings: `Cormorant Garamond` (classic serif)
  - Body Text: `Fauna One` (contemplative reader font)
- **Primary Mascot:** The 3D Mindful Moon, a smiling, living sphere that reacts smoothly to user presence and meditation milestones.
